Night Audit din ka business close karne:
Night Audit is the process of closing the day's business – the hotel's 'day end'. At night a designated auditor does this:

1. Verify settlements of all outlets 2. Post room charges + plan meals on in-house guests 3. Handle Departures/no-shows 4. Print Reports (Daily Report, FOCC) 5. Change software date (rollover).

Analysis Night Audit in HMS is a guided process — starts with Charges Posting (Shift+C) and is completed with Night Audit Process (Shift+N). If you make a mistake, you can rollback it from Reverse Night Audit.

POS (Point of Sale) module is the complete billing system of all F&B outlets of the hotel — Restaurant, Bar, Room Service and specialty outlets (like TADKA).

Maintenance module hotel ki assets (AC,:
The Maintenance module is the system for the hotel's assets (AC, geyser, lights, lift, generator) and their repairs. Maintenance requests for guest rooms, public areas and the kitchen are tracked.

MAINTENANCE FLOW: Register assets (Location + Asset Master) → Complaint/request received (in the room or from HK/FO) → Technician assigned → Repair complete → Asset history. The preventive maintenance schedule is also tracked.

Mall Management module hotel ke attached:
The Mall Management module manages the shops and tenants of the hotel's attached mall/commercial complex — lease agreements, monthly utility billing (electricity/water meter reading), service charges.

MALL FLOW: Register shops (Shop Master) → Lease agreement (tenant, rent, deposit, terms) → Daily meter reading (electricity/water) → Monthly bill generation (rent + utilities + service charges) → Collection tracking.
Mall ki saari shops/shops units register: Register all mall shops/shop units — shop no., floor, area (sqft), type. The lease agreement attaches to this shop. Facility charges (CAM) are defined in the Charge Master, shop units in Unit Type, tenant mapping in Tenant Location.

Members Management module hotel ke loyal:
The Members Management module is the system for the hotel's loyalty/club membership program — registering members, giving them smart cards, recharging/loading the card, and granting membership facilities (restaurant discount, room discount).

MEMBER FLOW: Create category (Silver/Gold/Platinum) → Register member → Initialize + issue Smart Card → Recharge card → When the member visits the property, bill/pay via card → Reward points accumulate.
